claims.claim: He served as head of the Catechetical School of Alexandria and was later ordained a priest, eventually settling in Caesarea.
Unlike most earlier fathers, Origen was one of the first to treat the Book of Job in a comprehensive, verse‑by‑verse manner, filling a gap in patristic exegesis.
The Homilies on Job survive only in fragmentary form, preserved mainly in later catenae and a few Greek manuscripts rather than in a complete original edition.
